# Love letters, as generated by Christopher Strachey's "Loveletters" program (1952).
# shamelessly copied from https://github.com/gingerbeardman/loveletter
# Apparently Strachey's original code was lost.
start:
    <salu1> <salu2>,\n     <sent> <sent> <sent> <sent>\n     Yours <adv>,\n     The Manchester University Computer\n

sent:
        My <nounph> <verbph> your <nounph>.
        You are my <adj> <noun>.
        You are my <adj> <noun>, my <adj> <noun>.
        You are my <adj> <noun>, my <adj> <noun>, my <adj> <noun>.

nounph:
    <noun>
    <adj> <noun>

verbph:
    <verb>
    <adv> <verb>
